newsitem.title: SRI LANKA: Forward buying keeps Colombo rubber prices up.
newsitem.headline: Forward buying keeps Colombo rubber prices up.

text.p: Strong demand for latex and forward contracts kept rubber prices buoyant at the Colombo auction on Thursday, where 326 tonnes of latex and 39 tonnes of sheet were on offer, brokers said.
"Quantities on offer were fairly high, but demand was still there," said Upali Bandaranayake of brokers Forbes & Walker.
"There were a lot of inquiries for forwards too," Bandaranayake said.
He added quantities for sole crepe (used in shoe soles) were sold out until August. Sri Lanka is the world's only producer of natural sole crepe.
Best latex one-x, the purest grade, rose to 72 rupees per kilo from 71.75 rupees from Tuesday when the auction was last held.
Number one fetched 71 rupees as compared to 70.75 on Tuesday. RSS 1 dropped slightly to 62.85 from 63 rupees.
